entities.summary: Liane Lissa Sato is a retired female volleyball player from the United States and two-time Olympian. Sato won the bronze medal with the United States national team at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. She also competed at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, where she finished in seventh place. She was a defensive specialist with the national team.
